title: Emrys and the Wardrobe
author: Orsen Kavanagh
blurb: Quentin Amberdale, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
